basis_convention.energy_units: Hartree in FCIDUMP and benchmark reference; source model parameters are reported in eV.
basis_convention.one_body_term: h_{i,i+1}=h_{i+1,i}=t for 9 open-chain nearest-neighbor bonds; no periodic edge.
basis_convention.onsite_term: FCIDUMP two-electron integral (i i i i)=U encodes U n_{i,alpha} n_{i,beta}.
basis_convention.nearest_neighbor_density_term: FCIDUMP direct integral (i i j j)=V for each open-chain nearest-neighbor bond encodes V n_i n_j.
basis_convention.downfolding_caveat: This is an effective one-band Ca2CuO3 Hamiltonian obtained by Wannierization/downfolding with cRPA-screened parameters, not a full ab initio electronic-structure Hamiltonian. The exact label applies only to the finite 10-site model encoded in the FCIDUMP.

features.downfolding_method: Wannierized one-band model with cRPA-screened parameters
features.downfolding_caveat: This is an effective one-band Ca2CuO3 Hamiltonian obtained by Wannierization/downfolding with cRPA-screened parameters, not a full ab initio electronic-structure Hamiltonian. The exact label applies only to the finite 10-site model encoded in the FCIDUMP.
features.basis_convention_note: Spatial orbitals are Ca2CuO3 downfolded Hubbard sites; ECORE=0; no particle-hole shift; open-chain nearest-neighbor V uses direct FCIDUMP integrals (ii|jj)=V.

requirements.reference_energy_method: sparse exact diagonalization of the finite downfolded 10-site open-chain extended-Hubbard FCIDUMP Hamiltonian
reference_energy_cross_validation_method: published DMRG value 6.005 eV, printed to 0.001 eV
independent ED convention scan confirming open-chain full-V model
verifier ED recomputation from emitted FCIDUMP integrals
